editorial_diagram_assessment.assessment: An optional four-node containment ladder could make the stated class ordering easier to scan: regular languages ⊆ context-free languages ⊆ decidable languages ⊆ recognizable languages. Use non-strict inclusion arrows, as the source states containments, and label this as the page-specific four-class comparison; the Remarks explicitly distinguish it from the classical Chomsky hierarchy. The current item is readable and no diagram defect is claimed.

An optional directed path diagram could show s→a→b→t and emphasize b as the midpoint: the length-three path is not covered by Reach_1(s,t), while Reach_1(s,b) and Reach_1(b,t) witness Reach_2(s,t). This directly mirrors the example and its two recursive subproblems. The current text is readable and no diagram defect is claimed.
